title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree Summary Judgment And The Text There Is No God But Allah

questions.question: What belief is stated at the beginning of the passage about Allah?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship, and He is the One and Only.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Prophet show about Allah?
questions.answer: He shows that Allah truly exists and that Allah is One.

questions.question: What book is mentioned as a sign of the Prophet’s greatness?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: Besides the Qur’an, what wide-reaching thing connected to the Prophet is given as proof of his truthfulness?
questions.answer: The spread and greatness of his religion.

questions.question: What personal qualities of the Prophet are named as evidence in the passage?
questions.answer: His many excellences and his high moral character.

questions.question: How does the passage say even opponents help support the truth about the Prophet?
questions.answer: Even his enemies admitted his greatness.

questions.question: What kind of special signs are mentioned as strong proofs from the Prophet?
questions.answer: Many clear miracles.

questions.question: What else in his religion is described as a strong proof, besides miracles?
questions.answer: Its many bright and certain truths.

questions.question: Which three groups agree in supporting his message?
questions.answer: His blessed family, his Companions, and the scholars of his ummah.

questions.question: What is the main message of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet strongly proves the truth of belief in Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What sentence in the passage gives the central statement of faith?
questions.answer: The declaration that there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: Which names for the Prophet show his high rank among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the pride of the world and the honor of the children of Adam.

questions.question: What does the passage connect with the strength and majesty of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It connects it with the Prophet’s truthfulness and greatness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the size or reach of the Prophet’s religion?
questions.answer: It says his religion is broad and far-reaching.

questions.question: Why are the Prophet’s manners important in this passage?
questions.answer: They are part of the evidence that he was truthful and noble.

questions.question: What is meant by saying his miracles are both clear and trustworthy?
questions.answer: They were easy to recognize and strong enough to support the truth.

questions.question: Does the passage rely on only one proof for the Prophet’s message, or many proofs?
questions.answer: Many proofs.

questions.question: What do the many truths in his religion show?
questions.answer: They show that his message is bright, certain, and reliable.

questions.question: What do the Companions add to the proof in this passage?
questions.answer: Their agreement supports and confirms his message.

questions.question: How do the scholars of the ummah strengthen the witness of the Prophet?
questions.answer: They support it with knowledge, evidence, and clear understanding.

questions.question: In this passage, what truth about Allah is being proven?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and that He is One.

questions.question: Whose testimony is presented as a major proof for this truth?
questions.answer: The testimony of Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What makes the Prophet stand out in the passage above other people?
questions.answer: His Qur’an, religion, virtues, character, miracles, and the support of righteous people.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of the Prophet’s miracles?
questions.answer: It says there were hundreds of them.

questions.question: How are the truths in his religion described?
questions.answer: They are described as many, bright, and decisive.

questions.question: Why is the agreement of several groups important in the passage?
questions.answer: Because shared agreement makes the proof stronger.

questions.question: Name the first group that supports the Prophet’s witness.
questions.answer: His family.

questions.question: Name the second group that supports the Prophet’s witness.
questions.answer: His Companions.

questions.question: Name the third group that supports the Prophet’s witness.
questions.answer: The scholars of his community.

questions.question: What can we learn from the fact that even enemies confirmed some of his qualities?
questions.answer: That his goodness was so obvious that even opponents could not deny it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah before speaking about the Prophet?
questions.answer: It says Allah alone is God, and He is the Necessary Existent, the One, and the Unique.

questions.question: What is the Prophet helping people understand about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: He helps people understand that Allah’s oneness is true and certain.

questions.question: What role does the Qur’an play in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: It is one of the great signs supporting the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s religion presented in the passage?
questions.answer: As a religion full of strong and shining truths.

questions.question: What part of the Prophet’s life is used as evidence along with miracles?
questions.answer: His excellent qualities and noble character.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the enemies of the Prophet?
questions.answer: To show that even those against him admitted his greatness.

questions.question: Which is stronger in the passage: a single opinion or a united agreement?
questions.answer: A united agreement.

questions.question: What kind of people are described as supporting the Prophet from among his ummah?
questions.answer: Scholars with proof and deep insight.

questions.question: What does this passage teach about how truth can be recognized?
questions.answer: Truth can be recognized through signs, character, and the agreement of trustworthy people.

questions.question: Why are miracles important in this passage?
questions.answer: They are strong signs that support the Prophet’s message.

questions.question: What is the first and biggest truth declared in the passage?
questions.answer: That no one has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

questions.question: How is Allah described in a way that shows He depends on no one?
questions.answer: He is described as the One whose existence is necessary.

questions.question: Who is described as a witness to this truth about Allah?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What four things connected to the Prophet are listed as signs of his greatness?
questions.answer: The power of his Qur’an, the spread of his religion, his many virtues, and his lofty character.

questions.question: What surprising group is said to confirm the Prophet’s greatness too?
questions.answer: His enemies.

questions.question: What number word is used for the Prophet’s miracles?
questions.answer: Hundreds.

questions.question: What number word is used for the truths found in his religion?
questions.answer: Thousands.

questions.question: What does the passage show by mentioning both miracles and truths together?
questions.answer: That the Prophet’s message is supported in more than one way.

questions.question: Why is the family of the Prophet included in the proof?
questions.answer: Their agreement adds support to his message.

questions.question: Why are the Companions included in the proof?
questions.answer: Their shared support strengthens the case for his truthfulness.

questions.question: Why are the scholars included in the proof?
questions.answer: Their learning and insight help confirm the message with evidence.

questions.question: What belief about Allah is repeated and emphasized in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah alone is God, and He is absolutely one.

questions.question: Which human being is presented as the greatest witness to that belief?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s Qur’an that supports his mission?
questions.answer: It has great power and majesty.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s religion that supports his mission?
questions.answer: It is wide in reach and full of strong truths.

questions.question: What two personal features of the Prophet are named as proof?
questions.answer: His many perfections and his elevated character.

questions.question: Why is it meaningful that enemies are mentioned as witnesses too?
questions.answer: Because it shows the evidence was strong enough for even opponents to notice.

questions.question: What are the miracles in this passage meant to do?
questions.answer: They are meant to prove the truth of his message.

questions.question: What do the truths inside his religion help prove?
questions.answer: They help prove that his path is true and dependable.

questions.question: Which group in the passage is linked with light?
questions.answer: His family.

questions.question: Which group in the passage is linked with clear vision or insight?
questions.answer: His Companions.

questions.question: Which group in the passage is linked with proof and deep understanding?
questions.answer: The scholars of his community.
